# zabbix_host (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zabbix_host_group" "servers" {
  name = "Linux servers"
}

# Host monitored through its IP address.
resource "zabbix_host" "web01" {
  host        = "web01"
  name        = "Web server 01"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  groups      = [zabbix_host_group.servers.id]
  templates   = ["10001"] # Linux by Zabbix agent
  ip          = "192.0.2.10"
  port        = "10050"
}

# Host monitored through its DNS name.
resource "zabbix_host" "db01" {
  host   = "db01"
  groups = [zabbix_host_group.servers.id]
  use_ip = false
  dns    = "db01.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `groups` (Set of String) List of Host Group IDs to assign to this host
- `host` (String) Technical name of the host

### Optional

- `dns` (String) DNS name of the host agent interface
- `ip` (String) IP address of the host agent interface
- `port` (String) Main monitoring Port for the host agent interface
- `templates` (Set of String) List of Zabbix Template IDs to link to this host
- `use_ip` (Boolean) Whether to connect to the host interface via IP (true) or DNS (false)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the Zabbix host ID.
terraform import zabbix_host.web01 10631
```
